tools.descriptionOverride: Fetch the full configuration graph for a single loan product including all related objects (Fee_Set__c, Delinquency_Set__c, Floating_Rate_Index__c, MF_Account__c, etc.) with their nested children, every child relationship (accounting setup, provisioning, commission hierarchy), and a top-level fees map for Fee__c lookups. Call this after list_products to inspect a specific product in detail.

Diagnostic tool for understanding deploy equality. Returns a per-candidate mismatch report explaining why a record would or would not match against itself and other records sharing its Name. Useful when debugging why a deploy is producing "<name>-Copy-N" renames for records that look identical to a human.

Deploy a (possibly edited) Golden Copy product graph to the connected Salesforce org. Reference records (Fee_Set__c, Delinquency_Set__c, MF_Account__c, MF_Account_Type__c, etc.) are matched by Name and full content — reused if identical, renamed to "<name>-Copy-N" if a Name collides with different content, or freshly inserted when no match exists. The new Loan_Product__c Id is returned on success. THIS IS A DESTRUCTIVE OPERATION that creates records in the target org; prompt the user for confirmation before invoking.
Returns every Loan_Product__c in the connected Salesforce org as a lightweight list (Id, Name, Product Type, Status). Use this to discover product Ids before calling get_product.
